description: Innovate in Bengaluru This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience. About Lowe's Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 50 home improvement company serving approximately 17 million customer transactions a week in the U.S. With total fiscal year 2022 sales of over $97 billion, approximately $92 billion of sales were generated in the U.S., where Lowe's operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing and helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts. For more information, visit Lowes.com About Lowe's India At Lowe's India, we are the enablers who help create an engaging customer experience for our $97 billion home improvement business at Lowe's. Our 4,000+ associates work across Technology, Analytics, Business Operations, Finance & Accounting, Product Management, and Shared Services. We leverage new technologies and find innovative methods to ensure that Lowe's has a competitive edge in the market. To know more about Lowe's India, visit Lowes.co.in About The Team Our team brings together technology and business partners who genuinely enjoy building great products together. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, with product, engineering, design, and business teams partnering closely to turn ideas into meaningful outcomes. Across regions, we stay connected through shared goals, open communication, and a strong sense of teamwork. It’s a supportive, high-energy environment where diverse perspectives are valued and people show up for one another. This is a chance to join a team that cares deeply about impact, partnership, and building the future together. Job Summary The Product Manager is responsible for defining and delivering the vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities for an assigned product or product area. This role translates customer, business, and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user stories, measurable objectives, and prioritized work for cross-functional teams. Working closely with engineering, design, analytics, business partners, and product leadership, the Product Manager guides products and features through the development lifecycle, leads agile planning activities, and makes informed trade-off decisions to maximize customer and business value. The role also establishes product success metrics, monitors product health and performance, and uses data and customer insights to improve the user experience, drive adoption, and support broader portfolio and organizational goals. Roles & Responsibilities Core Responsibilities Build OKRs for the product scope to support product portfolio and organizational OKRs, and drive alignment with business partners. Own the customer/user journey for a given product or feature and make decisions that impact feature usability with engineering. Define and measure customer success metrics to ensure the product scope supports overall product OKRs. Articulate how product features relate to the product vision and build a roadmap for stakeholders. Lead Agile ceremonies and provide clarity on expectations while aligning workstreams across team members. Prioritize and ensure the delivery, support, and execution of a high-quality product. Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to evaluate trade-offs and prioritize features aligned with the overall product vision. Work with Product Leadership to provide input on engineering priorities within the defined product space. Participate in product marketing activities to drive understanding of the product among peers and leaders. Drive product plans and leverage data to support alignment and decision-making. Define functional and technical objectives, along with analytics requirements for the product. Establish product KPIs and consistently monitor product health and business impact. Partner with engineering teams to build tracking and monitoring systems required for product analytics. Years Of Experience 2 years of experience in two or more of the following: Product Management Project Management Business Analysis Program Management Experimentation Product Marketing 1 year of experience in Product and/or Experience Management. Education Qualification Required Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education, if applicable. Experience in an Agile software environment with strong writing ability. Experience working cross-functionally in a large organization. Experience working closely with senior leadership. Experience translating data into quantifiable actions and deliverables. Required Skill Set Primary Skills (Must Have) Product strategy, vision, and roadmap development Product lifecycle and feature management OKR definition, alignment, and measurement Product backlog ownership and prioritization Agile product development and ceremony leadership User story and product requirements development Customer journey and user experience management Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment Data-driven product decision-making Product analytics, success metrics, and product health monitoring Collaboration with engineering and technical teams Feature trade-off analysis and delivery execution Secondary Skills (Desired) Product marketing and product adoption Business analysis and process improvement Project and program management Customer research and usability testing Experimentation and outcome validation Competitive and market analysis Executive communication and presentation Relationship and expectation management Technical and functional requirements definition Analytics tracking and monitoring implementation Change management Strong written and verbal communication Your Impact The Product Manager owns the vision and strategy, roadmap, and feature definition for individual products within a product group. Responsibilities include writing stories to define outcomes and product requirements as well as planning and managing product features through the product development process. This role manages the product backlog while prioritizing work and making product-related decisions based on the needs and expectations of customers and stakeholders. Finally, this role will focus on identifying key gaps in product features, capturing product requirements, and defining outcomes or objectives and key results (OKRs). What You Will Do Builds OKRs for product scope to support product portfolio and organizational OKRs and drives alignment with business partners. Owns customer/user journey for a given product/feature level. Makes decisions that impact user experience on feature usability with engineering. Defines and measures customer success metrics to ensure the product scope supports the overall product OKRs. Articulates how product features relate to the product vision and builds a roadmap for all partners. Leads agile ceremonies and works with the team to provide clarity of expectations. Aligns necessary workstreams from team members to achieve the value of their product. Prioritizes and ensures the delivery, support, and execution of a high-quality product. Works with other product managers and business leaders to understand trade-offs and prioritization of features based on overall product vision. Influences feature design trade-offs to drive critical/mass adoption. Works with product leadership and provides input for engineering priorities of their defined product space. Participates in product marketing and uses it to drive deep understanding of the product they own with peers and leaders. Drives product plans for their defined product space and leverages data to help drive alignment. Defines objectives (functional and technical) and data required for analytics needed either independently or in conjunction with business partners for their product. Defines key metrics of the product and consistently monitors the health of the product and business impact. Partners with engineering teams to build tracking/monitoring systems needed to get to the data. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, engineering, communications, or related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable 2 years of experience in two or more of the following: project management, product management, business analysis, program management, experimentation, or product marketing 1 year of experience in product and/or experience management Experience in an agile software environment with strong writing ability Experience working cross-functionally in a large organization Experience working closely with senior leadership Experience translating data into quantifiable actions/deliverables Preferred Skills/Education Master’s degree in business administration or similar advanced degree Lowe's is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law. Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

description: About the Role : At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers. Being a Creator : Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically? Yes they do it here! We offer unique opportunities for PMs to upskill themselves and overlap with Devs and Designers. We believe PMs should participate in the creation process and make product specifications that is close to implementation. They Should : Own the vision of the organization Develop and foster a deep understanding of Domain - Payments Technology - Purescript/Haskell Design - Mobile UX/UI (Tools: Sketch, Flinto) Data - Payments user journey and conversions (Tools: SQL, Tableau & data science programming) Deliver impactful and time-bound results by getting hands on with all aspects of product development and leading by example Develop framework solutions that solve problems fundamentally Enable, Collaborate & Coordinate with various stakeholders to craft the optimal product Internal - Technical Product Analysts (TPAs), Developers, Designers, Business Development and Senior Management External - CxOs, Sr. Executives, PMs and Devs of Merchants, Banks and Vendors Improve & optimise product development processes continuously Apply if you have : Aspiration for value creation Aspiration for quality Genuine user empathy Openness and patience to learn harder things Systematic approach to problem solving Attitude and ability to get-things-done Effectively balance big picture / details Self-motivated and driven Persuasive without being forceful The Giver attitude Preferred Qualifications And Skills MBA with 1-3 years of professional experience in Product Management. Strong strategic mindset along with exceptional execution capabilities and rigor. Proven expertise in stakeholder management Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams Why work in Juspay? Payments.. big deal? Yes, it is a big deal. The wind is strongly blowing in favor of electronic payments - India wants to buy/order everything online, go cashless (regulation) and can’t have enough of using smartphones! Startups and internet businesses currently see a payment’ success rate of 60% ( 40 out of 100 people fail during the payments process!). These businesses that will define our future are absolutely dependent on solving digital payments. Big industry with bigger problems to solve! How can Engineering solve this? Payments is a complex ecosystem involving banks, RBI regulations, payment networks, telecom infrastructure, online and offline merchants. There is no way to align all these stars without radical engineering innovation. Talk to us about it. What does Juspay offer? You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. We live & breathe the art of building amazing products with impeccable design and engineering. We want more innovators and a little bit of madness to take it further. For us office is like home with everything needed to make us comfortably code all day and chill out too. We have a full size piano, drums and a Shruti box if you are into music :) Lots of books, pictionary and interesting people to talk to about varied subjects - art, philosophy and of course about how to do the highest feats of engineering/design. We take an active interest in helping people reach their highest potential.

description: Location: Luxembourg Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Do you thrive in environments that challenge and inspire you? Would you like to grow within a team that values both excellence and enjoyment at work? Taleo Consulting is an international management consulting group with offices in France, Luxembourg, Belgium, The Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain, Singapore, Portugal, and Italy . We’ve grown into a team of 450+ talented professionals across 10 offices worldwide, partnering with leading organizations in Financial, Life Sciences, Retail, and Energy - Sectors , to drive transformation and deliver lasting impact. At Taleo, you’ll find more than just a job. You’ll join a community of ambitious consultants who share a passion for growth, innovation, and teamwork. Together, we create an environment where you can develop your skills, take on new challenges, and truly make a difference. What Will You Do? At Taleo Consulting, we believe that our growth starts with our people. When our consultants thrive, so do our clients. Motivated, curious, and passionate professionals make a real impact, not only on their own careers but also on the success of the organizations they support. We’re looking for individuals who embody our values and help us foster strong, trust-based relationships with both our clients and our teams across the globe. Our success is built on the talent, collaboration, and commitment of our people and we’re now looking for a BA Funds Onboarding to join our journey : Responsibilities Gather and analyze business requirements related to the onboarding of new Private Equity and Real Estate (PERE) funds. Coordinate end-to-end fund onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth transition from project initiation to business-as-usual operations. Act as the main liaison between Business, Operations, Fund Administration, IT, Legal, Compliance and external stakeholders throughout the onboarding lifecycle. Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria for development teams. Support the operational setup of new fund structures, including static data, cash accounts, investor information and operational workflows. Perform impact assessments and ensure regulatory, operational and technical requirements are captured and implemented. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validate business scenarios and manage defect resolution through to production sign-off. Monitor project progress, risks, dependencies and deliverables while ensuring timelines are met. Support fund migrations, operating model changes and lifecycle events such as restructurings, liquidations and transfers. Produce functional documentation, process flows and implementation reports to support operational teams. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related field. Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Funds Onboarding Analyst or Implementation Analyst within Asset Management, Fund Administration or Private Capital. Strong knowledge of Private Equity and Real Estate (PERE) fund structures and onboarding processes. Good understanding of the investment fund lifecycle, fund migration and operational implementation activities. Experience gathering business requirements and producing functional specifications. Familiarity with Fund Administration, Transfer Agency, Custody and Middle Office processes. Experience working with multiple stakeholders across Business, Operations, IT, Compliance and Legal teams. Knowledge of financial products and operational data, including static data, cash accounts, FX transactions and investment vehicles. Experience coordinating UAT, defect management and production deployment. Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills. Experience working in Agile or hybrid project environments is considered an asset.

description: Vacature Product Manager Bouw mee aan de toekomst van voorraadbeheer Bij BarTrack geloven we dat voorraadbeheer en bestellen slimmer, eenvoudiger en efficiënter kan. Met onze software helpen we installateurs, technische groothandels en andere organisaties om altijd grip te hebben op hun materiaal. Van het beheren van voorraadlocaties tot het automatisch bestellen van artikelen: BarTrack brengt het hele proces samen in één platform. Ons team groeit snel en daarmee ook onze ambities. Daarom zoeken we een Product Manager die de brug vormt tussen onze klanten, collega's en developers. Iemand die ervoor zorgt dat de juiste functionaliteiten worden ontwikkeld én dat iedereen begrijpt hoe deze optimaal gebruikt kunnen worden. Wat ga je doen? Als Product Manager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling van BarTrack. Je bepaalt samen met de directie de productvisie en vertaalt deze naar een heldere roadmap. Je verzamelt wensen vanuit klanten, implementatie, support, sales en marketing en maakt hierin de juiste afwegingen. Je werkt dagelijks samen met ons developmentteam. Je zorgt ervoor dat developers duidelijke requirements ontvangen, bewaakt de voortgang en test nieuwe functionaliteiten voordat deze worden uitgerold. Maar jouw verantwoordelijkheid stopt daar niet. Je zorgt ervoor dat iedere nieuwe functionaliteit succesvol wordt geïntroduceerd binnen de organisatie én bij onze klanten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de documentatie, schrijft release notes en zorgt dat implementatie, support en marketing precies weten wat er verandert. Kortom: jij bent de eigenaar van het product. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwikkelen en bewaken van de productvisie en roadmap. Vertalen van klantwensen naar concrete verbeteringen. Prioriteren van nieuwe functionaliteiten. Schrijven van functionele requirements en user stories. Aansturen en begeleiden van het developmentteam. Testen en accepteren van nieuwe functionaliteiten. Coördineren van software releases. Verantwoordelijk voor duidelijke productdocumentatie en release notes. Afstemmen met implementatie, support, sales en marketing. Signaleren van verbeterkansen op basis van klantfeedback en data. Continu verbeteren van BarTrack. Wie zoeken wij? Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en houdt ervan om processen slimmer te maken. Je kunt goed schakelen tussen techniek en praktijk en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar begrijpelijke oplossingen. Je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en krijgt energie van samenwerken met verschillende disciplines. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt een wo-opleiding afgerond. Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring in een rol als Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analist of een vergelijkbare functie. Je hebt affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling. Je hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt prioriteiten stellen en beslissingen nemen. Je werkt gestructureerd en denkt procesmatig. Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands. Waarom werken bij BarTrack? Bij BarTrack geloven we dat de beste ideeën ontstaan door samen te werken. We zijn een klein en ambitieus team waarin iedereen elkaar kent, gemakkelijk bij elkaar binnenloopt en samen verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het eindresultaat. Beslissingen worden snel genomen en jouw werk heeft direct invloed op onze klanten én op de ontwikkeling van ons product. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om mee te denken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Geen logge organisatie met eindeloze overlegstructuren, maar een omgeving waarin je echt het verschil kunt maken. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen €4.100 en €5.500 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, plus 8% vakantiegeld . 30 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om jouw rol vorm te geven. Een sleutelrol binnen een groeiend softwarebedrijf waar jouw ideeën direct impact hebben. Een klein, betrokken en enthousiast team met korte lijnen. Een moderne laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed uit te voeren. Een fijne werkomgeving waar samenwerken centraal staat. Enthousiast? Lijkt het je leuk om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van BarTrack? Stuur je CV en een kort bericht waarin je vertelt waarom jij enthousiast wordt van deze functie naar joelle.hable@bartrack.com . ﻿We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

Dienstverband : Fulltime Locatie : Rotterdam HQ Taal : Nederlands & Engels (NL/EN) Bouw, verbeter en beheer jouw eigen productportfolio. Bij Fresh ’n Rebel ben je als Product Manager geen doorgeefluik en geen manager op afstand. Jij bent eigenaar van jouw productportfolio en verantwoordelijk voor het volledige traject: van idee en ontwikkeling tot introductie en doorontwikkeling. Je kent jouw producten door en door; van specificaties, materialen en prestaties tot kwaliteit, risico’s en maakbaarheid. Tegelijkertijd houd je overzicht over projecten, planningen en afhankelijkheden. Je zorgt ervoor dat collega’s in Rotterdam en China én externe partners weten wat er moet gebeuren om producten succesvol op de markt te brengen. Je bent productdenker, projectmanager, aanjager en kwaliteitsbewaker in één. Jouw rol Als Product Manager werk je intensief samen met Product Development, Design, Quality, Compliance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing en Sales. Daarnaast schakel je dagelijks met leveranciers, ontwikkelaars en productiepartners. Je neemt eigenaarschap, stelt prioriteiten en zorgt ervoor dat projecten blijven bewegen. Ontbreekt informatie, loopt een besluit vertraging op of komt een deadline in gevaar? Dan pak jij het initiatief en zorg je voor een oplossing. Wat ga je doen? Je bent verantwoordelijk voor jouw productportfolio en de volledige productlevenscyclus: van idee en briefing tot ontwikkeling, introductie en optimalisatie. Je vertaalt marktontwikkelingen, consumentenbehoeften, commerciële kansen en productdata naar nieuwe productideeën, specificaties en verbeterprojecten. Je begeleidt productontwikkeling van concept tot massaproductie. Je beoordeelt samples, test functionaliteiten, vergelijkt materialen, analyseert kwaliteitsvraagstukken en geeft feedback op product, verpakking en gebruikerservaring. Je bewaakt planningen, deadlines, afhankelijkheden en mijlpalen en houdt collega’s in Rotterdam en China, evenals externe partners, op koers. Je signaleert risico’s tijdig, stelt prioriteiten en bewaakt continu de balans tussen design, kwaliteit, functionaliteit, kostprijs, maakbaarheid en snelheid. Je zorgt ervoor dat productspecificaties, documentatie en productinformatie correct en up-to-date zijn. Je werkt samen met Marketing en Sales aan succesvolle productintroducties. Je bezoekt waar nodig collega’s, leveranciers en productiepartners in China. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken een Product Manager die diepgaande productkennis combineert met sterk projectmanagement en een groot gevoel voor eigenaarschap. Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en kritisch. Je wilt begrijpen hoe een product werkt, waarom bepaalde keuzes zijn gemaakt en hoe het nóg beter kan. Tegelijkertijd behoud je overzicht over meerdere projecten, stakeholders en deadlines. Je bent hands-on ingesteld en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om zelf zaken op te pakken; van het testen van samples en controleren van specificaties tot het opvolgen van acties en het actualiseren van planningen. Je communiceert helder, legt afspraken vast en durft collega’s en partners aan te spreken wanneer dat nodig is. Daarnaast breng je mee: HBO+ werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring in productmanagement, productontwikkeling, projectmanagement of een vergelijkbare functie. Ervaring met fysieke consumentenproducten. Ervaring binnen consumentenelektronica, accessoires, lifestyleproducten of internationale productie is een pré. Sterk analytisch vermogen en oog voor detail. Uitstekende organisatorische vaardigheden. Een proactieve, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Ervaring met internationale samenwerking, bij voorkeur met Chinese leveranciers en productiepartners. Wat maakt jou succesvol? Je bent succesvol wanneer je jouw producten inhoudelijk kent én altijd inzicht hebt in de status van je projecten. Je creëert duidelijkheid, houdt vaart in processen en voorkomt verrassingen door vooruit te denken, de juiste vragen te stellen en problemen vroegtijdig te signaleren. Dankzij jouw aanpak worden goede ideeën vertaald naar sterke, betrouwbare producten die op tijd klaar zijn voor de markt. What’s in it for you? Bij Fresh ’n Rebel kom je terecht in een dynamische en ondernemende werkomgeving waar een echte niet lullen maar poetsen-mentaliteit wordt gewaardeerd. Daarnaast bieden wij: Een goed salaris. Personeelskorting op onze kleurrijke producten. Reiskostenvergoeding. Gezellige vrijdagmiddagborrels. Volop ruimte voor initiatief, ontwikkeling en eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Uiteraard de leukste collega’s van Rotterdam. Over Fresh ’n Rebel Fresh ’n Rebel is een Rotterdams lifestylemerk dat stijlvolle en kleurrijke consumentenelektronica ontwikkelt. Wij combineren technologie, design en persoonlijkheid in producten die het dagelijks leven nét wat leuker maken. Vanuit onze teams in Rotterdam en China werken we samen met internationale leveranciers en productiepartners aan producten die uitblinken in design, gebruikservaring en kwaliteit. Bij Fresh ’n Rebel krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, ideeën uit te werken en direct invloed uit te oefenen op de producten die in heel Europa op de markt worden gebracht. Ben jij de perfecte match? Zie jij jezelf als de Product Manager die onze producten naar een hoger niveau tilt? Stuur dan je CV en motivatie naar recruitment@freshnrebel.com onder vermelding van "Product Manager".
